values.note: Booked through CampLife, in season only: the engine took April 1 to November 8 in 2026 and refused 2027 dates; the policy text says March 21 to November 30. Off season is first-come, first-served. Sites free at arrival can be taken at the office. After 14 nights leave for at least 48 hours.

note: Inside Glendale Fish & Wildlife Area near Montgomery, in the woods near 1,000-acre Dogwood Lake; popular with anglers and hunters. Leased from Indiana DNR to and run by the Daviess-Martin Joint County Parks & Recreation Department. --Claude
summary: Base changed $17.12-35.31 -> $33-40 (live engine; the $24.61 table is stale and non-electric isn't the base). Dropped the $7 admission from the fee note (DNR: Admission Free). Added 50A, 44-ft pads, flush toilets, water, dump, CampLife booking, 14-night limit. Count 120, year-round confirmed. Not waterfront stands.
flags: FEE CHANGE, please look: non-electric is $20 Tue / $23 Sat before tax. I kept the base at electric $33 because the non-electric type is sold as 'Tent' with 'small parking pad' or 'all grass area' and the engine lists no equipment per site, so a 23-ft motorhome's fit there isn't stated. 'Each site can have either one camper and two tents' suggests a camper is allowed, so if you'd rather count them the base is $20. The old rate table on /glendale-fwa/camping/ ($24.61/$32.10/$35.31 and $17.12/$20.33/$23.54 with tax; winter $15/$10) is still published but the engine charges more; the operator's new page says 2026 pricing was updated. nightly_high $40 is the Saturday rate; holiday not readable (the dates tried were October, past holiday windows).

ADMISSION: the stored fee note had 'daily admission $7'. Neither West Boggs page mentions it, the engine quote has no such item (two vehicle tags come with the site), and the DNR's property page says 'Admission Free'. Removed. No fees.entrance written.

RESERVATION FEE: park says '$3.50 booking fee per site', CampLife's own charge, not stored per the CampLife recipe. The estimates carry a per-stay charge of ~$4.24 (non-electric) and ~$4.66 (electric).

WEBSITE: replace the two lines with https://westboggs.com/glendale-fwa/ (current page; /camping/ is an older page with stale rates) and the DNR page. PHONE (stored empty): 812-644-6107, campground office, per the DNR page, CampLife and Google; West Boggs 812-295-3421.

WHO RUNS IT: Daviess-Martin Joint County Parks & Rec (West Boggs Park) under a DNR lease; DNR says 'under concession'. Public books ordinary nights. Local stands. Google 4.6 from 132. Rule: 'Minors may not stay overnight without a parent or guardian', ordinary.

WATER: not waterfront stands, despite the operator's 'Nestled on the shores of Dogwood Lake' (claim differs, so I checked). Imagery at 1 m/px: the east loop ends ~100 m from the lake and the south end of the main loop ~70 m from an arm of it, full canopy between. Across all 120 CampLife site descriptions none mentions the lake: they are 'backing up to the woods' or 'center of the loop'. I did not open the 100+ individual site photos, so a filtered view can't be ruled out, but none is claimed. Overpass was down; distances are imagery estimates.
PIN: 38.54942,-87.04214 sits inside the campground's loops; no move. Google's 38.5496,-87.0425 agrees. CampLife's own lat/long (38.55194,-87.05150) is off to the west, ignore.
ALERT: DNR 'Glendale FWA Alerts: None at this time.' Parts of Dogwood Lake close for waterfowl seasons; no effect on camping stated.
